[{"id":"1779869753871-user","role":"user","content":"What is my name?"},{"id":"1779869758755-ai","role":"ai","content":"I don’t know your name unless you tell me — I don’t have access to external accounts or personal data outside what you share in this chat. 

You can:
- Tell me your name now and I’ll use it in this conversation, or
- Ask me to suggest names (for a username, character, etc.), or
- Tell me how you’d like to be addressed (nickname, title).

Which would you like?","model":"gpt-5-mini","mode":"ask","reasoningEffort":"medium"}]
